project_context.archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon adapted for Premium Anime)
project_context.vibe: Cinematic, high-energy, mysterious. A premium gacha/RPG feel blending dark voids with explosive neon chakra energy and subtle organic ink/scroll textures.

usage_rules: H1/H2 (Bebas Neue): Use for levels, character names, massive section titles, and damage numbers. Must have tracking-wide or tracking-tight depending on size.
Body (Outfit): Use for HUD labels, stats, descriptions. Maintain high contrast.
No generic sans fonts (Inter, Roboto) allowed for headings.
Use text-shadow for damage numbers floating above characters.

surfaces_and_materials.menus_and_lobby: Use The 'Tracing Beam' or sharp 'Grid Borders' look. Dark backgrounds with 1px neon borders (cyan/orange).
surfaces_and_materials.battle_hud: Glassmorphism. Heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), dark sheer tint (bg-black/60), and top-only bright borders (border-t border-cyan-500/50). Keeps the battle visible.
surfaces_and_materials.cards_roster: Cardless or Neumorphic (Clay & Crisp). Sharp corners or max 4px radius. 1px bright border based on Rarity color.

layout_and_spacing.general: Mobile-first responsive. Use 'The Bento Grid Protocol' for the Lobby/Dashboard. Generous padding (p-6, p-8) for breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.battle_screen: Control Room Grid. Bottom-heavy combat HUD. Horizontal strip for party members. Circular or tight rectangular action buttons.

rules: Hover: Brighten border colors, slight text-shadow glow.
Turn Indicator: Active character portrait must have a pulsing drop-shadow (Chakra cyan glow).

testing_requirements.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements (buttons, links, form inputs, character cards, jutsu buttons, hp bars) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='attack-jutsu-button').

technical_constraints.file_extensions: CRITICAL: The project uses .js and .jsx files. Do NOT generate or expect .tsx files. All components must be written in Javascript (ES6+).

component_guidelines.login_register: Full-screen anime landscape background. Central glassmorphism panel. Customized Shadcn inputs (dark bg, sharp borders).
component_guidelines.dashboard_lobby: Left side: Hero character portrait. Right side: Bento grid navigation (Campaign, Arena, Roster). Top bar: Level, Gold, Energy.
component_guidelines.roster_collection: Grid layout. Character portraits with colored bottom borders indicating rarity. No standard Vercel cards.
component_guidelines.battle_hud: Wide immersive background. Isometric character placement. Bottom command cluster. Target highlighting via crosshair or glowing ground circle.

textures.description: Creased parchment for organic texture overlays.

characters_and_portraits.description: Samurai silhouette, use as enemy placeholder.
Glowing martial arts pose, use as action placeholder.

iconography.instructions: Use lucide-react for all standard icons. Ensure icons inside battle HUD have high contrast and slight glows if representing energy/magic.
